{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = data[data['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
sentinel_age = data[data['customer_age'] == -1]
print(f"Number of sentinel age values (-1): {len(sentinel_age)}")

# Check revenue format
print("First 5 revenue values:")
print(data['revenue'].head(5))

# Display data types
print("\nData types:")
print(data.dtypes)"}
